author: KiluaBoy
description: Hey everyone! I made this song last night, it makes me feel nostalgic somehow and gives me good vibes, hope you feel the same! I also felt like adding some weather effects, not the best ones i know, but i added'em anyways :P Use this music if you like in your games, or whatever art you are making. I would love to see what you guys do with it, so let me know if you want on my twitter : https://twitter.com/boykilua There are more songs on my SoundCloud account here: https://soundcloud.com/kilua-boy Hope you enjoy, Thanks!
